title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file on adapters/mod.rs
description: patch_file returned 'old_string not found' when attempting to add the WithThinking variant to src/moeb/src/adapters/mod.rs. Likely cause: CRLF vs LF line ending mismatch. Recovered immediately by write_file.
proposed_resolution: Normalize line endings in patch_file and read_file consistently on Windows, or document that write_file is preferred for Windows-hosted repositories.

title: Rubric criterion Pass with acknowledged failures: no-test-regression
description: The no-test-regression criterion was passed with acknowledged_failures noting that anthropic_tests.rs was modified to add 4 spec-required test cases. The criterion's pass condition states 'no test file edited', creating unavoidable tension when a spec mandates adding test coverage.
proposed_resolution: Clarify no-test-regression to distinguish additive test changes (adding new tests) from regressive test changes (modifying or deleting existing tests).

title: WithThinking unwrap required in query_agent.rs violates qualitative spec constraint
description: The moeb.reasoning-reviewer spec's qualitative rubric states WithThinking must not be referenced outside three specified files. However, query_agent.rs calls adapter.send() directly and required a second pre-unwrap arm for Rust exhaustive match compliance.
proposed_resolution: Update the spec's qualitative criterion to include query_agent.rs, or route query_agent through a shared unwrap helper in adapters/mod.rs.

title: Missing moeb tool: Read (start_run result file)
description: Used Read to read oversized start_run output from absolute temp path. moeb read_file cannot access paths outside the working directory.
proposed_resolution: Extend start_run to write large results to a moeb-accessible relative path, or add a moeb tool for reading kernel-generated output files by run_id.

title: Missing moeb tool: Bash
description: Used Bash for cargo build --release and cargo test. No moeb equivalent for shell command execution.
proposed_resolution: Introduce a moeb run_command tool for executing build and test verification commands.
